modelTournament.reason: Independent reviews found Luna and Terra stylistically strong but less reliable on lexical-unit boundaries and sense admission; reviewer variance means neither replaces the selected conservative GPT-4.1 pilot profile.

knownIssues: Phrase-bound lemmas can still be admitted as independent senses, as seen with sprake.
Definition and example can still mix place and duration uses, as seen with verblijf.
One reviewer found merged opportunity and occasion uses for gelegenheid.
Short canonical wording can match a source; exact definitions up to five tokens require manual review rather than automatic hard failure.
Optional collocations, synonyms, usage patterns, and idioms are intentionally disabled pending a separate audited enrichment stage.
publicationGate: No unattended, public, paid, or full-corpus generation is approved by this decision. Human article review and a separate licensing/database-rights decision remain mandatory.
